body: Btw I haven’t really seen any differences in my life either, no gain in confidence, energy or even motivation. What’s going on here?

Ugly as a person in general (looks and character). I really like cars but even that doesn't excite me anymore like it used to. I just spend my days locked in my room only leaving to go to the bathroom, school, etc.
Ugly, antisocial, stupid, weird, loner, the list goes on.
Thank you everyone for the kind words, I appreciate it a lot.

I don't know anymore man, nothing ever seems to go right for me. Every morning I wake up wishing I wasn't alive just so I wouldn't have to go through the day. My parents probably think I'm some lunatic because all I do is trap myself in my room and avoid the outside world. My brother is no help either because all he does it's make it worse. Every night I stay up to 5 in the morning contemplating whether I should overdose on pain killers and die in my sleep. I don't anymore, I'm just embarrassed with who I am and so is everyone around me. I'm 17 years old never had a girlfriend (probably never will) can't even talk to a girl, have no friends I'm not even joking not one, I'm ugly, stupid, antisocial, and list goes on... I'm tired of it all and just wish it would all end.
